population.source: CDP Bazaar discovery listings, deduplicated to one probe URL per host

verification.rule: same checks as monthly_report.verified(): payload hash, published key, Ed25519 signature, date and row count

operators_rule.rule: registrable domain (public suffix plus one label); an operator stopped when every one of its cohort hosts stopped

definitions.payment_gated: verdict in OK, WARN, V1, NON_EVM, BLOCKED on the day
definitions.stopped: no payment-gated verdict on any of the last 14 days of the window
definitions.stop_date: the day after the host's last payment-gated day
definitions.unsettled: not payment-gated on the last day, but payment-gated on one of the last 14
definitions.silence: a run of consecutive days on which a cohort host was not payment-gated
definitions.period_stopped: hosts (or operators) whose stop date falls in the period, out of those that had not stopped before it; the last period ends on settled_through
